title: Reciting the litany of Our Lady of Loreto, beseeching her to intercede for them, the old familiar words, holy Mary, holy virgin of virgins.
html_source:
A Litany is a kind of prayer used by Roman Catholics; it invokes either a number of saints, or one saint (usually the Virgin Mary) under many titles. This is an example of the latter kind; it addresses her primarily as Our Lady of Loreto

(who derives her name from the Holy House of Loreto, the house of Jesus' family, which is reputed to have miraculously flown to Europe). The various elaborate and metaphorical titles punctuate the remainder of the chapter, drawing an implicit metaphor between the Blessed Virgin and Gerty as an apotheosis of womanhood.
